tasks.title: Design PostgreSQL schema and migrations (users, roles, addresses, flowers, categories, stock, carts, orders, order items, payments, delivery status history, couriers, favorites) with encrypted address and contact fields
Finalize UI kit and screen specs: color tokens, typography, buttons, inputs, cards, chips, bottom sheets, tab bar, and the 6 screens in Figma-ready form
Set up Node.js/Express REST API skeleton, HTTPS config, environment config, error handling, and React and React Native app shells with shared theme and bottom navigation

Build user accounts: register, login, JWT sessions with bcrypt hashing, role-based access (Customer/Courier/Admin), saved address CRUD, account deletion request with 30-day purge job, and Account screen UI
Build catalog API and UI: category list, keyword search, price and color filters, indexed queries under 2s, Flower Catalog screen with grid cards, chips, and filter bottom sheet

Build cart and checkout: cart API and UI, address selector, delivery date and time-slot picker, Stripe PaymentIntent integration with webhook, order creation only on successful payment, declined-payment error banner, confirmation modal

Build delivery tracking: order status state machine, courier status update endpoints (including Mark as Delivered with timestamp), Order Tracking screen with status stepper, and Firebase Cloud Messaging push notifications on status change
Build order history screen and API: list orders with status and totals, status filter chips, order details, and one-tap Reorder into cart

Build admin panel (web React): flower add/edit with photo upload, price and stock updates reflected immediately in catalog, new paid order list, courier assignment that populates courier delivery list and notifies customer
Add DB indexes, seed data (flowers, categories, couriers, admin), and run load test at 200 concurrent users on catalog and checkout
End-to-end QA of acceptance criteria for F1-F5, accessibility and checkout flow check (max 5 steps, under 3 minutes), then deploy to staging with HTTPS and uptime monitoring

risks: Scope is large for a small team: three platforms (web, iOS, Android) plus admin; mitigate by sharing the API and logic, and shipping the customer flow first with admin as web-only.
Stripe payment and webhook handling may cause order and payment mismatches or delays in testing; mitigate by creating orders only from confirmed webhook events and using Stripe test mode early.
Push notifications and courier status flow (FCM setup, iOS APNs certificates) can slip schedule; mitigate by starting setup early and falling back to in-app polling for status.
Peak holiday load (Valentine's Day, Mother's Day) could breach the 2s and 99.5% targets; mitigate with indexes, caching of catalog queries, and an early load test.
Privacy requirements (encryption at rest, 30-day deletion) can be overlooked under time pressure; mitigate by building them into the schema and account tasks from the start.
